patterns: How can I pay for my order?
responses: You can pay using credit/debit cards, PayPal, or mobile money.
We accept all major payment methods including Visa, MasterCard, and PayPal.
Payments can be made at checkout using your preferred method.
Your payment may have been declined due to insufficient funds or incorrect billing details.
Please check if your card has expired or if your bank blocked the transaction.
Try using an alternative payment method or contact your bank for clarification.

patterns: Can I get an invoice for my order?
responses: Yes, you can download your invoice from your order history page.
We automatically send invoices to your email after a successful purchase.
If you didn't receive it, please contact support and we'll resend it.
Yes, we offer refunds according to our refund policy.
You can request a refund within 14 days of purchase.
If eligible, your refund will be processed within 5-7 business days.
No, all charges are clearly displayed at checkout.
We believe in full transparency, so you’ll never encounter hidden fees.
Taxes and shipping fees are included in your total order summary.
Standard shipping takes 3–7 business days.
Express shipping is available and takes 1–3 days.
Delivery time may vary based on your location.

patterns: How can I track my order?
responses: Once your order ships, we’ll send you a tracking link via email.
You can track your order in your account under 'My Orders.'
Use the tracking number provided to check delivery status on the courier’s website.
Yes, we ship internationally. Shipping costs and delivery times vary depending on the destination.
We offer international shipping to most countries.
Shipping charges and times will be calculated at checkout.

patterns: What happens if my package is lost?
responses: If your package is lost, contact our support immediately for assistance.
We’ll investigate and either resend the order or issue a refund.
Lost packages are rare, and we ensure secure tracking on all shipments.

patterns: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
responses: Yes, but only if your order hasn't shipped yet.
Please contact us as soon as possible to update your address.
Once shipped, address changes are not guaranteed.

patterns: I can't log into my account, what should I do?
responses: Try resetting your password using the 'Forgot Password' link.
Make sure your email and password are entered correctly.
Contact support if you’re still unable to log in.

patterns: The website is not loading properly, what could be wrong?
responses: Try clearing your browser cache and cookies.
Check your internet connection or try a different browser.
If the issue persists, let us know and we'll look into it.
Ensure the code hasn’t expired and meets the promotion conditions.
Promo codes are case-sensitive and may have usage limits.
Contact support for further assistance with applying discounts.

patterns: I didn’t receive a confirmation email.
responses: Check your spam or junk folder.
If it’s not there, ensure you entered the correct email during checkout.
Let us know and we’ll resend your confirmation.
